description.narrative: 1, UNCAC coalition: Strengthened coalition building that promotes a more transparent and inclusive UNCAC that is better implemented, higher global standards on anti-corruption, and increased civil society participation. 2. Number of trainings organized; number of CSOs from ODA countries benefitting from training or expertise shared; Number of tailored peer-support initiatives funded under new pilot (target of at least 10 small grants of 1,000-3,000 EURO each, allocated over 3 years) and description of type of support.

target.value: At least 5 training sessions; at least 20 groups receiving a peer-training; at least 4 peer-support initiatives in which the Coalition matches two groups and provides financial support.

actual.value: 5 trainings, each attended by 25+ participants; have not managed to launch peer support effort yet

target.value: At least 5 training sessions held for civil society groups (e.g., regional training sessions) where at least 20 groups receiving a peer-training; at least 3 in-depth peer-support initiatives in which the Coalition matches two groups and provides financial support.

actual.value:
PPartly achieved:
Organized 6 virtual training sessions for the UNCAC Coalition community in different regions were led by Open Contracting Partnership (procurement reforms), IFES (on political finance transparency) and International Lawyers Project (on sanctions regimes and how to utilize them), attended by more than 35 CSOs from ODA countries.
However, the pilot of peer-support efforts did not take place and were delayed to 2024 as we were not able to fill vacancies as the finalization of donor commitments was delayed.
